group_summaries.new_features_summary: Layout-polymorphic functions, unsigned unboxed integer primitive types, ocamldep `-modules-only`, and compact-frametable emitter plumbing.
group_summaries.new_features:
- **Layout-polymorphic functions** (`let poly_ f x = ...`) implemented across typedtree-to-tlambda and tlambda-to-slambda translation, along with application of such functions, by [Jack Rickard](https://github.com/Skepfyr) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#5870](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/5870))
- **Distinct unsigned unboxed integer primitive types** (`uint8_u`, `uint16_u`, `uint32_u`, `uint64_u`) added with the same kinds as their signed counterparts, letting the compiler distinguish signed and unsigned unboxed integers, by [Max Slater](https://github.com/TheNumbat) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6534](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6534)), which were then guarded behind the `small_numbers` extension along with a new `unativeint_u` type in the same follow-up ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6634](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6634))
- New `-modules-only` flag for `ocamldep` that behaves like `-modules` but omits the leading `file:` prefix from each output line, letting build rules consume dependency output directly without shell postprocessing, by [Jakub Staroń](https://github.com/staronj) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6540](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6540))
- `-dprofile` now works in combination with `-stop-after middle_end`, fixing a case where profiling output was previously suppressed by the early exit, by [Basile Clément](https://github.com/bclement-ocp) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6550](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6550))
- Emitter plumbing added across backend code emitters to enable **compact frametables**, laying groundwork for shorter frametables tracked in [oxcaml/oxcaml#6399](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6399), by [Nick Barnes](https://github.com/NickBarnes) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6488](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6488))
- New `split` statement added to `ocamltest`, by [Luke Maurer](https://github.com/lukemaurer) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6422](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6422))
- **Type shapes for `any` fields** implemented, allowing a type shape to be constructed even when field layouts of an `any`-kinded field are unknown, by [Luke Maurer](https://github.com/lukemaurer) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6403](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6403))
- Fixed a crash when an `any` type variable resolves to an unboxed product, by [Luke Maurer](https://github.com/lukemaurer) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6436](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6436))
- Fixed unsound argument value kinds in partial GADT matches, where calling-convention specialization could select the wrong value representation across GADT cases, by [Ryan Tjoa](https://github.com/rtjoa) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6356](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6356), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6533](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6533))
- Fixed reversed logic in `contains_no_escaping_local_allocs` for unboxed function wrappers, by [Jules Jacobs](https://github.com/julesjacobs) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6558](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6558))
- Fixed float32 double-rounding bug, by [Luke Maurer](https://github.com/lukemaurer) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6474](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6474))
- Fixed `%makearray_dynamic` for float kinds under `-no-flat-float-array`, by [Jules Jacobs](https://github.com/julesjacobs) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6486](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6486))
- Fixed missing safepoints (polls) in loops that only allocate locally, with a codegen test added to exhibit the bug before the fix, by [Xavier Clerc](https://github.com/xclerc) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6469](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6469))
- Removed unnecessary `caml_modify` calls for existential immediate types in mixed blocks and via better value kinds for type variables, reducing write-barrier overhead, by [Ryan Tjoa](https://github.com/rtjoa) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6631](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6631), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6633](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6633))
- Recursive-module unroll depth is now chosen adaptively for large module groups instead of using a fixed bound, by [Jules Jacobs](https://github.com/julesjacobs) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6532](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6532))
- Parameter allocation modes are now kept in sync when unboxing closures in the reaper, by [Miriam Vellacott](https://github.com/mirivella) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6543](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6543)), who also split the reaper into stages for LTO and added `reaper-rebuild`/`reaper-solve` entry points ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6627](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6627), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6632](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6632))
- `Dissector` link-input resolution reworked to parse each partition once and parallelize partial linking, by [Simon Spies](https://github.com/spiessimon) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6447](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6447)), building on resolving link inputs' object files through manifests by [Jakub Staroń](https://github.com/staronj) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6468](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6468))
- Custom `[@@or_null]` variants now get the same precise kind as `or_null`, by [Jules Jacobs](https://github.com/julesjacobs) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6500](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6500))
- Platform symbol prefix stripped from `DW_AT_linkage_name` in DWARF debug info, by [Mark Shinwell](https://github.com/mshinwell) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6506](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6506))
group_summaries.group_overview:
- Two of the five repositories in the group had recorded activity this week: [oxcaml/oxcaml](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml) and [oxcaml/opam-repository](https://github.com/oxcaml/opam-repository); [oxcaml/merlin](https://github.com/oxcaml/merlin), [oxcaml/js_of_ocaml](https://github.com/oxcaml/js_of_ocaml), and [janestreet/opam-repository](https://github.com/janestreet/opam-repository) had no tracked commits or pull requests.
- oxcaml/oxcaml landed layout-polymorphic functions ([oxcaml/oxcaml#5870](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/5870)), distinct unsigned unboxed integer types ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6534](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6534), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6634](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6634)), and a series of backend/Flambda2 correctness fixes, with 87 PRs open at week's end.
- [Mark Shinwell](https://github.com/mshinwell) and [Pierre Chambart](https://github.com/chambart) opened a large, coordinated wave of Flambda 2 design and roadmap issues ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6581](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6581)-[oxcaml/oxcaml#6629](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6629)), the dominant theme of the week.
- oxcaml/opam-repository saw a single PR from [David Allsopp](https://github.com/dra27-js) adding OxCaml compatibility for `mdx.2.6.0` ([oxcaml/opam-repository#55](https://github.com/oxcaml/opam-repository/pull/55)), left open pending a `dune` version fix.
- [Liam Stevenson](https://github.com/liam923) continued Merlin synchronization work in oxcaml/oxcaml, landing the "Merlin for 5.4.0-ox3" sync ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6557](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6557)) even though the [oxcaml/merlin](https://github.com/oxcaml/merlin) repository itself recorded no activity this week.
group_summaries.activity_summary: 87 PRs remain open in oxcaml/oxcaml including a faulting-safepoints rework and AVX-512 intrinsics; opam-repository's mdx PR awaits a dune fix.
group_summaries.activity:
- Notable **open, unmerged PRs** from this week include [Nick Barnes](https://github.com/NickBarnes)'s rework of faulting safepoints ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6551](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6551)) and a #include cleanup in the runtime ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6562](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6562)); [Vlad Turcuman](https://github.com/vladturcuman)'s draft `-runtime-variant baremetal` ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6549](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6549)); [Max Slater](https://github.com/TheNumbat)'s draft AVX-512 intrinsics work ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6578](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6578)); [Zesen Qian](https://github.com/riaqn)'s `-no-crc <module>` flag to drop a dependency's import-table rows for byte-stable artifacts ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6561](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6561)) and generic mode-axis exhaustion in `out_type` ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6569](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6569)); and [Vincent Laviron](https://github.com/lthls)'s removal of mutable-string support in Flambda2 ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6570](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6570))
- [@zhizhuoxin](https://github.com/zhizhuoxin) opened several related PRs on `noalloc` primitives and allocation-mode checking, including forcing allocation to be local ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6548](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6548)), a quick check for the allocation-mode axis ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6559](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6559)), and preventing `noalloc` primitives from forcing closures to allocate ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6571](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6571)), after an earlier no-stack variant was closed without merging ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6547](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6547))
- [Jakub Bachurski](https://github.com/jbachurski) opened a cluster of PRs on metaprogramming internals: consistent naming of quotes and splices ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6575](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6575)), renaming `code` to `expr` in `Predef` ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6576](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6576)), enabling `ocamlformat` in `camlinternalQuote` ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6577](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6577)), a dynamic scope extrusion check ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6579](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6579)), refactoring quoting of predefined names ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6635](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6635)), and fixes for mode constraints in quotes ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6647](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6647)), and merged an earlier fix avoiding ambiguous use of the phrase "top-level" in metaprogramming docs ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6565](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6565))
- [Liam Stevenson](https://github.com/liam923) continued Merlin synchronization work, merging an updated import script, build rules for Merlin, and enforcement that Merlin stays in sync ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6034](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6034), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6042](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6042), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6245](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6245)), landing the larger "Merlin for 5.4.0-ox3" sync ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6557](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6557)), and opening further synchronization changes and jkind-annotation fixups still under review ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6563](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6563), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6566](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6566)); [Kostia Balytskyi](https://github.com/ikostia) also merged an import of upstream `ocaml/merlin` PR 2104 ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6555](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6555))
- Backend and codegen work merged this week spans [Xavier Clerc](https://github.com/xclerc)'s CFG block merging for identical blocks differing only in debug info ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6541](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6541)), a `Simplify_terminator` fix ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6370](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6370)), skipping prologue/epilogue when computing liveness for stack checks ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6472](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6472)), and factoring a shared dead-code predicate into `Cfg.is_dead_basic` ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6301](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6301)), alongside [Nathanaëlle Courant](https://github.com/Ekdohibs)'s x86 `TEST`-instead-of-`CMP` optimization for boolean materialization, co-authored with [@ttebbi-janestreet](https://github.com/ttebbi-janestreet) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6552](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6552))
- Flambda2 fixes merged include [Basile Clément](https://github.com/bclement-ocp)'s restriction of relation recovery to relations that hold globally ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6502](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6502)) and a fix to stop silently forgetting about bottom ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6347](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6347)), and [Basile Clément](https://github.com/bclement-ocp)'s in-progress work on `Tmod` type_desc infrastructure merged by [Jules Jacobs](https://github.com/julesjacobs) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6430](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6430))
- Flambda2 export info's table of contents was moved into CMX file sections by [Jack Rickard](https://github.com/Skepfyr) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6455](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6455)), and `Is_parameter` was moved to `middle_end/` and recorded in `Backend_var.Provenance` by [Mark Shinwell](https://github.com/mshinwell) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6504](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6504)), who also merged a fix comparing `dinfo_uid` in `Debuginfo.Dbg.compare` ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6503](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6503))
- Codegen test coverage expanded with [James Rayman](https://github.com/jra4)'s tests for matching on unboxed ints ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6391](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6391)) and sign-extension fix for `Typedtree.Const_untagged_char` payloads ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6535](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6535)), and [Xavier Clerc](https://github.com/xclerc)'s `[%%expect_asm_full]` codegen-test attribute plus a stack-check/SIMD fix ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6334](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6334))
- Two mode-polymorphism PRs from [Jules Jacobs](https://github.com/julesjacobs) on closure conventions when compiling against a `.cmi` and lowering generic mode variables in `lower_nongen` were closed without merging after review ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6567](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6567), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6568](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6568)), alongside closures of a lock-free skiplist race-condition fix by [Nick Barnes](https://github.com/NickBarnes) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6346](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6346)) and driver flags `-X gc-space-overhead`/`-X gc-idle-floor` by [Jules Jacobs](https://github.com/julesjacobs) ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6485](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/pull/6485))
- [Mark Shinwell](https://github.com/mshinwell) opened a large set of Flambda 2 design and planning issues covering breadth-first meet ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6581](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6581)), n-way join and its performance ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6583](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6583), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6586](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6586)), lifted-constants restrictions ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6588](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6588)), enabling match-in-match, the reaper, functor size limits, and the new zero-alloc analysis in production on the JS tree ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6589](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6589), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6590](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6590), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6591](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6591), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6599](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6599)), and closed a batch of older reaper/testing-infrastructure design issues as resolved ([oxcaml/oxcaml#4693](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/4693), [oxcaml/oxcaml#4694](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/4694), [oxcaml/oxcaml#4696](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/4696), [oxcaml/oxcaml#4698](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/4698), [oxcaml/oxcaml#4700](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/4700), [oxcaml/oxcaml#5253](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/5253), [oxcaml/oxcaml#5271](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/5271))
- [Pierre Chambart](https://github.com/chambart) opened companion Flambda 2 issues on speculative inlining, argument-use estimation, code-size/cost-metric correctness, reducing and delaying CMX loading, lazy join, and splitting the typing environment between toplevel and function level ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6582](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6582), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6585](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6585), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6587](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6587), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6601](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6601), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6602](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6602), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6605](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6605), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6607](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6607)); [Vincent Laviron](https://github.com/lthls) opened related issues on Flambda2 logging, removing binary join, speculative variables, variant unboxing, better closure types, and dominator scoping during Simplify ([oxcaml/oxcaml#6594](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6594), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6600](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6600), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6603](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6603), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6604](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6604), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6606](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6606), [oxcaml/oxcaml#6608](https://github.com/oxcaml/oxcaml/issues/6608))
- In oxcaml/opam-repository, [David Allsopp](https://github.com/dra27-js) opened a PR adding **OxCaml compatibility** for `mdx.2.6.0` ([oxcaml/opam-repository#55](https://github.com/oxcaml/opam-repository/pull/55)), a small four-line change across four files mirroring [ocaml/opam-repository#30305](https://github.com/ocaml/opam-repository/issues/30305), noting its second commit will be superseded once that upstream PR merges; the PR remains open and unmerged pending a dune-side fix.

- oxcaml/opam-repository activity remained minimal, with a single OxCaml-compatibility PR left open pending an external dune dependency ([oxcaml/opam-repository#55](https://github.com/oxcaml/opam-repository/pull/55)), while [oxcaml/merlin](https://github.com/oxcaml/merlin), [oxcaml/js_of_ocaml](https://github.com/oxcaml/js_of_ocaml), and [janestreet/opam-repository](https://github.com/janestreet/opam-repository) had no recorded activity at all.

group_summaries.new_features_summary: New `Option.try_value`, `Result.try_value`, and `Obj.hash_variant` merged in ocaml/ocaml; toplevel gains module-dependent function tracing.
group_summaries.new_features:
- Standard library gains `Option.try_value` and `Result.try_value`, returning a fallback value or an error handler's result respectively, implemented by [Michael Neumann](https://github.com/mneumann) with review by [Daniel Bünzli](https://github.com/dbuenzli) and [David Allsopp](https://github.com/dra27) ([ocaml/ocaml#14941](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14941))
- `Btype.hash_variant` (the compiler's implementation of the runtime's `caml_hash_variant`) moved to a new public `Obj.hash_variant` function by [David Allsopp](https://github.com/dra27) ([ocaml/ocaml#14939](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14939))
- Toplevel gains limited support for tracing module-dependent functions via `modular explicits`, implemented by [Florian Angeletti](https://github.com/Octachron) ([ocaml/ocaml#14707](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14707))
- Fixed a memory leak in the runtime by bounding the size of the internal fiber/stack cache, work by [Vesa Karvonen](https://github.com/polytypic) and [Florian Angeletti](https://github.com/Octachron), merged by [Florian Angeletti](https://github.com/Octachron) ([ocaml/ocaml#14940](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14940))
- Fixed RISC-V assembler errors from `Ireturn_addr` and `Iextcall` with stack arguments when the offset exceeds a 12-bit immediate, by [Tim McGilchrist](https://github.com/tmcgilchrist) ([ocaml/ocaml#14943](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14943))
- Typing recovery mechanism extended to keep continuation information inside the `Typedtree` via a dedicated type, helping editors report more than one typing error, by [Xavier Van de Woestyne](https://github.com/xvw) ([ocaml/ocaml#14946](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14946), [ocaml/ocaml#14945](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14945))
- Added a level to abbreviations in `Texpand` as part of the ongoing expansion/well-foundedness rework, by [Jacques Garrigue](https://github.com/garrigue) ([ocaml/ocaml#14801](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14801))
- Overhauled the locale-handling code used for mingw/msvc float-to-string and string-to-float conversions in `runtime/floats.c`, by [David Allsopp](https://github.com/dra27) ([ocaml/ocaml#10258](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/10258))
- `OCAMLTOP_INCLUDE_PATH` is now ignored during the build, fixing opam installation failures when the variable holds an invalid value, by [David Allsopp](https://github.com/dra27) ([ocaml/ocaml#14914](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14914))
- Added documentation for the ocamllex `-w` warning-list argument to the man page, covering the `missing-case` warning, by [Jeannalyse](https://github.com/Jeannalyse) ([ocaml/ocaml#14944](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14944), closing [ocaml/ocaml#14902](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14902))
- Updated documentation for runtime functions using `nanosleep`, by [David Allsopp](https://github.com/dra27) ([ocaml/ocaml#14948](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14948))
group_summaries.group_overview:
- ocaml/ocaml merged nine PRs this week, including new `Option.try_value`/`Result.try_value` stdlib functions ([ocaml/ocaml#14941](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14941)) and a runtime fiber-cache memory-leak fix ([ocaml/ocaml#14940](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14940))
- A draft Hashtbl reimplementation for deterministic iteration order, submitted as a closing internship contribution by [Jeannalyse](https://github.com/Jeannalyse), drew pushback over generic-structure performance tradeoffs ([ocaml/ocaml#14956](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14956))
- A cluster of typechecker path-equivalence refactors landed in `ctype.ml` from [Gabriel Scherer](https://github.com/gasche) and [Florian Angeletti](https://github.com/Octachron) ([ocaml/ocaml#14947](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14947), [ocaml/ocaml#14950](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14950), [ocaml/ocaml#14952](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14952))
- ocaml/RFCs saw two PRs: one proposing removal of the rejected modular-IOs RFC ([ocaml/RFCs#63](https://github.com/ocaml/RFCs/issues/63)) and continued revision of the Destinations API RFC by [Gabriel Radanne](https://github.com/Drup) ([ocaml/RFCs#62](https://github.com/ocaml/RFCs/issues/62))
group_summaries.activity_summary: New PRs opened for a Hashtbl redesign and ctype refactors in ocaml/ocaml, while ocaml/RFCs saw a PR to remove the rejected IO-channels RFC.
group_summaries.activity:
- [Jeannalyse](https://github.com/Jeannalyse) opened a draft **reimplementation of Hashtbl** giving deterministic iteration order regardless of the random seed, as a final contribution from a research internship with [Gabriel Scherer](https://github.com/gasche) ([ocaml/ocaml#14956](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14956)); [Florian Angeletti](https://github.com/Octachron) pushed back on trading generic-structure performance for this safety property
- [Gabriel Scherer](https://github.com/gasche) opened a series of **typechecker path-equivalence refactors** in `ctype.ml`, including normalizing types in `tconstr`-equivalence fast paths ([ocaml/ocaml#14950](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14950)), clarifying uses of `Env_unscoped.path_equiv` ([ocaml/ocaml#14947](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14947)), and an optimization for path-equivalence checks modulo normalization built on top of those ([ocaml/ocaml#14952](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14952)), following on from [Florian Angeletti](https://github.com/Octachron)'s path-equivalence-modulo-aliases work ([ocaml/ocaml#14927](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14927))
- [David Allsopp](https://github.com/dra27) opened a PR to bump the required autoconf version to 2.72 ([ocaml/ocaml#14953](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14953)), addressing an issue about CI/local autoconf version mismatches ([ocaml/ocaml#14937](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14937))
- [Khalid](https://github.com/khalidbelk) opened a PR adding `Sys.file_exists'`, a variant raising `Sys_error` on failure instead of returning `false` ([ocaml/ocaml#14951](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14951)), addressing a long-standing request ([ocaml/ocaml#12393](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/12393))
- [Benoit](https://github.com/benjub) opened a PR adding `Stdlib.Char.Ascii.is_punct`, completing the set of ASCII predicates left out of an earlier PR ([ocaml/ocaml#14957](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14957))
- [Stefan Muenzel](https://github.com/smuenzel) opened PRs for smaller generated code for stack reallocation on AMD64 ([ocaml/ocaml#14954](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14954)) and a fix for expect-test trailing output ([ocaml/ocaml#14959](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14959)), alongside earlier open work inlining the full-application part of `caml_apply` ([ocaml/ocaml#14925](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14925)) and eliding the occurs-check for fresh-variable parameters ([ocaml/ocaml#14913](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14913))
- [Gabriel Scherer](https://github.com/gasche) opened a PR disabling `testsuite/tests/misc/sorts.ml`, noting it is a benchmark rather than a correctness test ([ocaml/ocaml#14960](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14960)), and briefly opened then closed a `ocamlc -g` reoptimization attempt ([ocaml/ocaml#14961](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14961))
- [Simon Cruanes](https://github.com/c-cube) closed his **extensible IO channels** RFC implementation, noting stdlib-committee discussion had stalled ([ocaml/ocaml#14775](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14775)), and closed `Buffer.iter_chunks` ([ocaml/ocaml#12931](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/12931))
- [Gabriel Scherer](https://github.com/gasche) closed `Dynarray.unsafe_{get,set}` after concluding the safety-reasoning tradeoffs were not worth the 1.4-2.5x microbenchmark speedup, following questions from [Daniel Bünzli](https://github.com/dbuenzli) ([ocaml/ocaml#14864](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14864))
- [v-gb](https://github.com/v-gb) closed a PR improving `Map`/`Set.union` complexity on related maps after [Gabriel Scherer](https://github.com/gasche) identified it violated the `union` specification when the merge function is non-trivial; [Nicolás Ojeda Bär](https://github.com/nojb) noted the `Set.union` fast path remained valid and that LexiFi has related `inter`/`diff` optimizations to offer ([ocaml/ocaml#14949](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14949))
- Ongoing open work continues on structured compiler diagnostics for developer tooling by [Florian Angeletti](https://github.com/Octachron) ([ocaml/ocaml#13766](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/13766)), new GC-pacing logic by [Damien Doligez](https://github.com/damiendoligez) ([ocaml/ocaml#14796](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14796)), link-time linking support by [Raphaël Proust](https://github.com/raphael-proust) ([ocaml/ocaml#14895](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14895)), exposing `caml_ba_compare` and related bigarray functions by [David Allsopp](https://github.com/dra27) ([ocaml/ocaml#14804](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14804)), and POWER-architecture frame-pointer support by [Tim McGilchrist](https://github.com/tmcgilchrist) ([ocaml/ocaml#14505](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14505))
- Cross-platform build maintenance continued with [David Allsopp](https://github.com/dra27)'s build-environment sanitization ([ocaml/ocaml#14915](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14915)) and macOS opam-sandbox compiler-cloning fix ([ocaml/ocaml#14923](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14923)), [Antonin Décimo](https://github.com/MisterDA)'s Cygwin build fixes ([ocaml/ocaml#14921](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14921)) and `CAMLthread_local` C/C++ interoperability improvement ([ocaml/ocaml#14934](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14934)), and [Kate](https://github.com/kit-ty-kate)'s macOS fix for `opam clone` ([ocaml/ocaml#14901](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14901))
- Runtime fixes remain open for a musl/Intel `sigaltstack` issue by [Nat Mote](https://github.com/nmote) ([ocaml/ocaml#14933](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14933)), printing `errno` on `sigaltstack` errors by [Nathan Taylor](https://github.com/dijkstracula) ([ocaml/ocaml#14928](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14928)), and dropping redundant memory-model fences around atomic RMWs on AArch64 by [Sebastian Pop](https://github.com/sebpop) ([ocaml/ocaml#14936](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14936))
- [Gabriel Scherer](https://github.com/gasche) has an open fix for record updates with unchanged `[@atomic]` fields ([ocaml/ocaml#14935](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14935)), addressing a reported issue where functional updates of atomic records fail to emit atomic loads ([ocaml/ocaml#14918](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14918))
- [Simon Cruanes](https://github.com/c-cube) opened a PR proposing to remove the RFC on modular IOs ([ocaml/RFCs#63](https://github.com/ocaml/RFCs/issues/63))
- [Gabriel Radanne](https://github.com/Drup) continued work on the **Destinations API** RFC, updating the proposal for an API to manipulate destinations ([ocaml/RFCs#62](https://github.com/ocaml/RFCs/issues/62))
group_summaries.cross_repository_work: - [Simon Cruanes](https://github.com/c-cube) closed his extensible IO channels implementation in ocaml/ocaml after stdlib-committee discussion stalled ([ocaml/ocaml#14775](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14775)), then opened a follow-up PR in ocaml/RFCs to formally remove the corresponding rejected modular-IOs RFC ([ocaml/RFCs#63](https://github.com/ocaml/RFCs/issues/63))
group_summaries.notable_discussions:
- [Jeannalyse](https://github.com/Jeannalyse)'s draft Hashtbl reimplementation for deterministic iteration order drew disagreement from [Florian Angeletti](https://github.com/Octachron), who argued against slowing down a performance-sensitive generic data structure to guard against programmer error ([ocaml/ocaml#14956](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14956))
- [Daniel Bünzli](https://github.com/dbuenzli) opened a "Show and tell" discussion proposing new `String` search functions (`find_sub`/`rfind_sub`) based on a two-way string-search algorithm, following up on [ocaml/ocaml#14068](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14068), with a gist and benchmark script for feedback ([ocaml/ocaml#14099](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/discussions/14099))
- [Austin Theriault](https://github.com/ajbt200128) described Semgrep's need for per-domain timeouts and discussed with [Gabriel Scherer](https://github.com/gasche) whether `Domain.interrupt` can safely interact with effect handlers, referencing the asynchronous-exception-masking work in [ocaml/ocaml#8961](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/8961) ([ocaml/ocaml#14955](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14955))
- The autoconf version mismatch between CI and local hygiene checks was debated by [Antonin Décimo](https://github.com/MisterDA), [David Allsopp](https://github.com/dra27), and others, weighing bleeding-edge autoconf against long-term stability ([ocaml/ocaml#14937](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14937))
- [Simon Cruanes](https://github.com/c-cube)'s extensible IO channels RFC implementation was closed after stdlib-committee discussion stalled without a resolution ([ocaml/ocaml#14775](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14775))
group_summaries.emerging_trends:
- Repeated tension between performance and safety/reasoning guarantees in stdlib data structures, seen in the closed `Dynarray.unsafe_{get,set}` PR ([ocaml/ocaml#14864](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14864)) and the contested Hashtbl redesign ([ocaml/ocaml#14956](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14956))
- An active cluster of typechecker path-equivalence refactoring in `ctype.ml` from [Gabriel Scherer](https://github.com/gasche) and [Florian Angeletti](https://github.com/Octachron), building incrementally on each other's PRs ([ocaml/ocaml#14927](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14927), [ocaml/ocaml#14947](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14947), [ocaml/ocaml#14950](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14950), [ocaml/ocaml#14952](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14952))
- [David Allsopp](https://github.com/dra27) driving a cluster of cross-platform build and locale maintenance across Windows/mingw, Cygwin, and macOS opam sandboxing ([ocaml/ocaml#14914](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14914), [ocaml/ocaml#14915](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14915), [ocaml/ocaml#14923](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14923), [ocaml/ocaml#14953](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14953), [ocaml/ocaml#10258](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/10258))
- Continued incremental progress on the typing-recovery mechanism for multi-error editor integration, spanning several small merged PRs in the same week ([ocaml/ocaml#14945](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14945), [ocaml/ocaml#14946](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14946))
- ocaml/RFCs activity was reactive to ocaml/ocaml decisions this week, with the modular-IOs RFC removal following directly from the closed IO-channels PR ([ocaml/RFCs#63](https://github.com/ocaml/RFCs/issues/63), [ocaml/ocaml#14775](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml/issues/14775))

group_summaries.brief_summary: Eio published v1.4 with Flow.null and macOS fixes; ocaml-uring saw only issue discussion, and seven other group repos had no recorded activity.
group_summaries.new_features_summary: Eio v1.4 shipped Flow.null, a macOS select() fallback, and improved error messages; no other repo in the group shipped features.
group_summaries.new_features:
- [ocaml-multicore/eio](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio): Added `Flow.null`, a sink/source pair modeled on `/dev/null`, by [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm) and [Thomas Leonard](https://github.com/talex5), suggested by [Jon Sterling](https://github.com/jonsterling) ([ocaml-multicore/eio#894](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/894))
- [ocaml-multicore/eio](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio): `eio_posix` now falls back to a custom `select()` stub when `poll()` returns `POLLNVAL`, fixing a macOS crash writing to `/dev/null`, by [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm) ([ocaml-multicore/eio#893](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/893), fixes [ocaml-multicore/eio#757](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/757))
- [ocaml-multicore/eio](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio): `Net.getaddrinfo` and related lookups now include the queried hostname/service in error messages, by [Thomas Leonard](https://github.com/talex5) ([ocaml-multicore/eio#900](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/900))
- [ocaml-multicore/eio](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio): `eio_linux` directory reading no longer returns an empty batch before end-of-file, preventing truncated listings on FUSE filesystems, by [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm) ([ocaml-multicore/eio#897](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/897))
- [ocaml-multicore/eio](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio): `eio_linux` now surfaces the real underlying error when `chmod` on a symlink fails via `/proc/self/fd/`, by [Thomas Leonard](https://github.com/talex5) ([ocaml-multicore/eio#901](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/901), test fix [ocaml-multicore/eio#903](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/903))
- [ocaml-multicore/eio](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio): `fork_action` now rejects uid/gid/pid values that overflow the underlying C types instead of silently truncating them, by [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm) ([ocaml-multicore/eio#895](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/895))
- [ocaml-multicore/eio](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio): Function applications were eta-expanded to support compilation under OxCaml, by [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm) ([ocaml-multicore/eio#898](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/898))
- [ocaml-multicore/eio](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio): `eio_unix_fork_error` now calls `_exit` automatically instead of relying on every caller to do so, by [Thomas Leonard](https://github.com/talex5) ([ocaml-multicore/eio#896](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/896), fixes [ocaml-multicore/eio#818](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/818))
- [ocaml-multicore/eio](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio): Published the **v1.4 release**, consolidating the above fixes and features into `CHANGES.md`, by [Thomas Leonard](https://github.com/talex5) ([ocaml-multicore/eio#904](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/904))
group_summaries.group_overview:
- [ocaml-multicore/eio](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio) published its **v1.4 release**, merging eight PRs covering `Flow.null`, a macOS `select()` fallback, error-message improvements, and OxCaml compatibility work
- [ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring) had no commits merged; activity was limited to two issue threads, one resolved as a false positive ([ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#160](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring/issues/160)) and one still open ([ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#156](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring/issues/156))
- [ocaml-multicore/domainslib](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/domainslib), [ocaml-multicore/meio](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/meio), [ocaml-multicore/saturn](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/saturn), [ocaml-multicore/eio-trace](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio-trace), [ocaml-multicore/picos](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/picos), [ocaml-multicore/kcas](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/kcas), and [ocaml-multicore/ocaml-iomux](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/ocaml-iomux) recorded no activity for this period
group_summaries.activity_summary: A pty-to-EOF PR was opened in eio while v1.4 shipped, and a suspected double-free in ocaml-uring was diagnosed and closed as a false positive.
group_summaries.activity:
- [ocaml-multicore/eio](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio): A PR converting tty `EIO` errors into `End_of_file` for `Eio_unix.Pty` was opened by [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm), addressing reads from a closed pty raising an unhandled I/O error ([ocaml-multicore/eio#905](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/905), fixes [ocaml-multicore/eio#902](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/902))
- [ocaml-multicore/eio](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio): [Thomas Gazagnaire](https://github.com/samoht) reported a relative-path bug in `Eio.Path.mkdirs`, closed after investigation ([ocaml-multicore/eio#906](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/906)), and opened a request to add a `~follow` argument to `open_in`/`open_out` ([ocaml-multicore/eio#899](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/899))
- [ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring): [Vesa Karvonen](https://github.com/polytypic) opened and then closed a suspected double-free/dangling-pointer report in `uring_stubs.c`, surfaced by an AI-assisted code review, after confirming the leftover pointer is never referenced ([ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#160](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring/issues/160))
- [ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring): [Isaac Freund](https://github.com/ifreund) added a comment to the open vendored-liburing portability issue, describing a build failure on Chimera Linux and requesting a system-liburing build option for Debian packaging ([ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#156](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring/issues/156))
group_summaries.cross_repository_work: - No direct cross-repository dependencies or coordinated work were observed this week; [ocaml-multicore/eio](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio) and [ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring) were the only active repositories, and their changes (eio's v1.4 release and ocaml-uring's issue triage) were independent of one another
group_summaries.notable_discussions:
- On [ocaml-multicore/eio#899](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/899), [Thomas Gazagnaire](https://github.com/samoht) and [Thomas Leonard](https://github.com/talex5) discussed adding `~follow` to `open_in`/`open_out`, covering use cases like opening raw block devices with `O_NOFOLLOW` and safely building disk images from a source tree
- On [ocaml-multicore/eio#902](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/902), [Anil Madhavapeddy](https://github.com/avsm) and [Thomas Leonard](https://github.com/talex5) debated wrapping `Eio_unix.Pty` specifically versus converting `EIO` to end-of-file generically whenever `isatty()` is true, settling on the general approach implemented in [ocaml-multicore/eio#905](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/905)
- On [ocaml-multicore/eio#893](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/893), review of the macOS `select()` fallback covered `fd_set` sizing beyond 1024 descriptors, whether to restrict the workaround to `__APPLE__` only, and correct `CAMLparam` usage in the new C stub
- On [ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring#160](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/ocaml-uring/issues/160), [Vesa Karvonen](https://github.com/polytypic) raised a memory-safety concern about `Ring_val(v_uring)` potentially dangling after a failed `io_uring_queue_init_params` call, then self-corrected once it was clear the leftover pointer is never dereferenced
group_summaries.emerging_trends:

- **Platform-specific edge-case hardening** continued in eio, spanning macOS `poll()`/`select()` behavior ([ocaml-multicore/eio#893](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/893)) and forward compatibility with the OxCaml compiler ([ocaml-multicore/eio#898](https://github.com/ocaml-multicore/eio/issues/898))
